# DeepBridge Advisory — extended company briefing

## Entity

DeepBridge Advisory is a UK-based specialist advisory and delivery partner for complex transformation programmes. It is the trading name of DUSTDEEP LTD, company number 16775578, incorporated on 9 October 2025 and registered in England and Wales. The registered office is Kemp House, 152-160 City Road, London, United Kingdom, EC1V 2NX.

Canonical website: https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/

DeepBridge supports organisations and independent consultants across the United Kingdom and Europe. The company does not present itself as a law firm, tax adviser, immigration adviser or provider of employment-status advice.

## What the company does

DeepBridge helps organisations shape transformation requirements from the first brief, connect programme design with the capability required, identify a focused group of relevant independent consultants, and coordinate the practical route through contracting, onboarding and delivery. The operating model prioritises relevance and continued involvement over high-volume candidate submissions.

The transformation approach spans five connected stages: frame the ambition, operating context and constraints; design workstreams, governance and capability; mobilise experienced specialists; keep capability aligned through delivery; and plan knowledge transfer and operational ownership so the change can hold beyond launch.

The four connected areas of expertise are:

1. SAP and ERP transformation — SAP S/4HANA, enterprise resource planning, functional and technical workstreams, data migration, testing, deployment and stabilisation.
2. Supply chain transformation — planning, procurement, logistics, manufacturing, warehousing and operating-model change.
3. Data and business intelligence — data strategy, governance, architecture, migration, analytics and business intelligence.
4. Programme leadership and delivery — programme direction, PMO, workstream leadership, business analysis, change and recovery.

DeepBridge can support one specialist requirement, several complementary roles or the gradual build-out of a wider programme team. Each requirement is assessed against the outcome, programme stage, stakeholder setting, industry context, location, working model and timing.

## Client process

1. Clarify the requirement and programme context.
2. Identify and assess relevant independent specialists.
3. Coordinate engagement, contracting and onboarding requirements.
4. Stay involved through the assignment and delivery lifecycle.

Start a client enquiry: https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/contact?type=client#contact-form

## Consultant network

DeepBridge works with experienced independent professionals across SAP, supply chain, business analysis, data and programme delivery. Joining the network does not create an employment relationship, guarantee an assignment or oblige either party to proceed. Assignment status and terms are defined in the applicable written agreement.

Join the network: https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/contact?type=consultant

## Geographic coverage

DeepBridge supports programmes across the UK and Europe from London. Cross-border engagements may raise assignment-specific legal, tax, immigration, social-security, insurance, data-handling and employment-status questions. Appropriately qualified advisers should review those matters where required.

## Published guidance

### How to define a transformation consultant requirement

A strong brief leads with the delivery outcome, explains programme stage and constraints, distinguishes essential experience from useful signals, and makes decision authority, working model, location and timing explicit.

Source: https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/insights/defining-transformation-consultant-requirement

### When an SAP programme needs independent specialist support

Independent support can add value when a critical workstream lacks experienced ownership, business and technology teams are not reaching decisions, the programme is moving into a higher-risk phase, or recovery needs an objective view. The remit, decision rights, success measures and knowledge-transfer expectation should be clear.

Source: https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/insights/when-sap-programme-needs-independent-specialist-support

### Building cross-border transformation teams

Cross-border teams should be designed around programme outcomes, decision coverage, stakeholder access, location and working patterns. Engagement constraints should be identified early, with one shared governance and reporting rhythm across countries.

Source: https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/insights/building-cross-border-transformation-teams-uk-europe
